idea-plugin.name: Bitnami Image Gate
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the Bitnami image lines that broke on 2025-09-29, when versioned docker.io/bitnami tags moved to the frozen docker.io/bitnamilegacy archive

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Bitnami Image Gate: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 7 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/bitnami-image-catalog-gate (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/bitnami-image-catalog-gate

action.text: Bitnami Image Gate: Check This File
action.description: Run Bitnami Image Gate on the file in the editor
